name: admin-pages-need-i18nprovider
hook: Admin pages using useTranslations or client components should wrap content in I18nProvider
body: Admin pages in src/app/(payload)/admin/ that render client-side content should wrap their content in I18nProvider, similar to the chat page pattern. This ensures proper i18n context even if child components don't directly use translation hooks.
why: The PDF conversion page was rendering blank until I added I18nProvider, even though the components themselves don't use translation hooks. The admin layout doesn't provide I18nProvider for page content directly.

name: explicit-height-for-admin-pages
hook: Admin pages should set explicit height to prevent blank rendering
body: Admin pages that render full-height content should set explicit height style (e.g., height: calc(100vh - 64px)) on a container div to ensure proper layout. This matches the pattern used in the chat page.
why: Without explicit height, some admin pages may render with zero height in certain conditions, showing a blank page even when the admin layout is loading correctly.
